title: Bocce Bar & Restaurant
address:
3252 NE 1st Ave, Unit 107
Miami, Florida 33137
United States
description:
Bocce Bar & Restaurant opened in Midtown Miami in December 2013 under Samba Brands Management, the group also behind SushiSamba and Sugarcane Raw Bar & Grill. The Italian enoteca and bistro blends a dramatic, modern look with rustic touches across 4,900 square feet of indoor and outdoor seating.

It was built around Miami's first official outdoor bocce ball court, with a dedicated Vespa parking area out front.
